chunks: "Among the sunnah (prophetic tradition) is the burial of hair, nails, and blood."

key_terms.السُّنَّةِ: the sunnah (prophetic tradition) as an endorsed normative practice
key_terms.الظُّفُرِ: nail or fingernail/toenail that has been clipped
key_terms.دَفْنَ: burying or interring something in the ground

ai.seo_question: What does the sunnah say about disposing of hair, nails, and blood?
ai.summary: This hadith states that burying removed hair, nails, and blood is among the sunnah (prophetic tradition). It reflects an etiquette of cleanliness and respectful disposal of bodily remnants within Islamic practice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Among the Sunnah (traditions) is the burial of hair, nails, and blood."
